title: SQS: Bayesian DNN Compression through Sparse Quantized Sub-distributions
abstract: arXiv:2510.08999v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Compressing large-scale neural networks is essential for deploying models on resource-constrained devices. Most existing methods adopt weight pruning or low-bit quantization individually, often resulting in suboptimal compression rates to preserve acceptable performance drops. We introduce a unified framework for simultaneous pruning and low-bit quantization via Bayesian variational learning (\method), which achieves higher compression rates than prior baselines while maintaining comparable performance. The key idea is to employ a spike-and-slab prior to induce sparsity and model quantized weights using Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) to enable low-bit precision. Due to the intractability of the objective involving spike-and-slab priors with GMMs, we derive an efficient approximation that facilitates effective compression with minimal accuracy loss. In theory, we provide a consistent result for our proposed variational approach

translated_title: SQS：基于稀疏量化子分布的贝叶斯深度神经网络压缩
translated_abstract: 压缩大规模神经网络对于在资源受限设备上部署模型至关重要。大多数现有方法单独采用权重剪枝或低比特量化，往往导致为了保持可接受的性能损失而只能获得不理想的压缩率。我们提出了一个统一的框架（\method），通过贝叶斯变分学习同时进行剪枝和低比特量化，在保持相当性能的同时实现了比先前基线更高的压缩率。其核心思想是采用尖峰-厚板（spike-and-slab）先验来诱导稀疏性，并使用高斯混合模型（GMMs）对量化权重进行建模，从而实现低比特精度。由于包含尖峰-厚板先验与高斯混合模型的目标函数难以直接求解，我们推导了一种高效的近似方法，能够在最小精度损失的情况下实现有效压缩。在理论方面，我们为所提出的变分方法提供了一致性结果。
tldr: 该论文提出SQS框架，利用贝叶斯变分学习统一权重剪枝与低比特量化——通过尖峰-厚板先验诱导稀疏性、用高斯混合模型建模量化权重，并给出高效近似方法与理论一致性保证，从而在保持模型性能的同时实现比现有方法更高的压缩率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SQS, a unified Bayesian variational learning framework that combines weight pruning and low-bit quantization via spike-and-slab priors and Gaussian Mixture Models, achieving higher compression rates with minimal accuracy loss and theoretical consistency guarantees.
